name: csoai-measurement
description: Council of AI (CSOAI) — independent AI-governance measurement tools over MCP: verify signed cards, query the GSPC board, run deterministic probes. Measurement, not certification. Every result recomputable (Ed25519).

quality.notes: Deterministic predicates, no LLM-as-judge; every tool returns signed/recomputable results; honest UNMEASURED handling.

tools.name: gspc_verify
tools.description: Verify a signed GSPC measurement card offline (Ed25519). Returns VALID or REJECTED.

tools.name: gspc_axes
tools.description: Query the live GSPC board: 13 of 14 axes measured, per-axis scores, intervals, McNemar separation.

tools.name: gspc_probe
tools.description: Run a deterministic probe (temp=0, exact-label predicate) against frozen anchors. Never the judge — the predicate is.
